raw_blocks: Delivering life’s essential data when, where, and how you need it

Consensus Cloud Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCSI) is the world’s largest digital fax provider and a trusted global source for the transformation, enhancement and secure exchange of digital information. We leverage our 25-year history of success by providing advanced solutions for regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, insurance, real estate and manufacturing, as well as state and federal government, which result in improved outcomes.
HITRUST CSF ® Certified digital cloud faxing
Digital signature with automated form fill
Intelligent data extraction using natural language processing (NLP) and artificial intelligence (AI)
Interoperability for healthcare IT, including real-time event notification and direct secure messaging (DSM)

Our solutions can be combined with best-in-class managed services for optimal implementations. For more information about Consensus, visit consensus.com and follow @ConsensusCS on Twitter to learn more.

pages.raw_title: Fax Online with eFax | Secure, Scalable, Enterprise Cloud Fax
pages.raw_meta: eFax provides secure, scalable, enterprise-grade cloud faxing with HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC compliance. Send and receive faxes from any device—computer, tablet, or smartphone.
raw_blocks: A better experience starts here.
Fax Online with eFax ® The Brand Trusted by Millions

For 30 years, eFax ® has powered secure information exchange for the world’s most regulated organizations, combining HIPAA-compliant online faxing with intelligent automation, cloud integrations, and workflow optimization.
Start Faxing Now Compare All Plans
Recognized by leaders, trusted by experts
An eFax ® solution for every level of your business

Pick the plan that fits how you work. Online faxing from your inbox or mobile, with fax-to-email, email-to-fax, and a free local or toll-free fax number. Send a fax online from any device, no machine required. HIPAA compliant cloud fax across Personal, Business, and Corporate plans.
For Individuals & Small Business
for individuals: 200 monthly pages to the US and Canada, one user license, and local or toll-free fax number
for growing teams: 500 monthly pages to 51 countries, five user licenses, and a local or toll-free fax number with scalable options and volume discounts that grow with your team.
What our portfolio makes possible
Turn Documents Into Intelligent Data
eFax ® Clarity uses purpose-built healthcare AI to extract and structure data from inbound faxes, scans, and PDF’s. No manual rekeying. Faster intake, referrals, and clinical workflows.

eFax ® Conductor and eFax ® Unite bridge your EHRs, networks, and applications with FHIR, HL7, REST, and DirectTrust support. Critical information stays visible and accessible across the continuum of care.
Learn About eFax® Conductor Learn About eFax® Unite
Modernize Legacy Federal Fax Systems

ECFax ® , powered by eFax ® , is the FedRAMP ® High Authorized cloud fax solution built specifically for U.S. federal government use. Hosted on AWS GovCloud, ECFax scales on-demand to hundreds of millions of pages per month. ECFax provides secure data transfer for vital, regulated documents with a modern, cloud-native design.
Embed eFax ® in Every System You Run

Connect eFax ® to your existing tech stack with our developer-first API and 100+ integrations across CRMs, ERPs, and EHRs. SDK support for Python, Java, and C#. REST, FHIR, HL7, and DirectTrust supported. 99.9% uptime, AES 256-bit storage, TLS 1.2 transmission.
Enterprise Deployment and Integration Specialists

The eFax ® Managed Services Team helps you architect, deploy, and optimize our technology across your entire enterprise. From custom API setups and EHR migrations to compliance support and complex multi-site rollouts, our experts work alongside your team from day one.
For Regulated Industries & Enterprise
Secure Cloud Fax with Advanced AI and Interoperability

Global leaders across healthcare, finance, and government trust eFax ® to power high-volume document logistics. By combining our secure routing network with AI-driven processing and seamless data transformation, we turn unstructured documents into actionable business intelligence.
Enterprise Cloud Faxing – HITRUST Certified and trusted by the Fortune 500.
FedRAMP® Authorized – Secure cloud faxing engineered for government agencies.
AI-Powered Processing – Automated clinical data extraction and parsing at scale.
Data Transformation – Seamless FHIR and HL7 integration across disparate systems.
Unified Enterprise Inbox – Direct secure messaging and consolidated workflows.
Seamless Workflow Integration – Directly embed secure cloud faxing into your existing enterprise applications.
Customer success across every scale
From solo practitioners to multi-state health systems, eFax ® delivers a better experience for the people who depend on us.
Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc.

We were averaging 121 fax errors per week. I was handling 15 complaints a week from all levels of our organization and external partners. It was non-stop…[the eFax ® integration with athenaOne®] just works! I’ve gone from 121 fax errors per week down to 12, and so far every one of those errors I’ve chased down has turned out to be a problem on the sender’s side. It is literally like night and day!”
Alvin Yip Director of Informatics Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc.
*eFax ® estimates that healthcare organizations can save up to 70% on fax infrastructure costs.
Definitely. With online fax services like eFax®, you can easily send faxes from your computer or any internet-enabled device, eliminating the need for a traditional fax machine or phone line.
Yes, online fax services like eFax® are secure and use encryption to protect your documents.

Millions of users rely on eFax® for their digital faxing needs, drawn by our two-decade legacy as the world’s leading online fax service. Our reputation is solidified through the trust of Fortune 500 corporations and thriving small businesses globally. eFax® facilitates efficient online faxing and provides HIPAA-compliant plans tailored to regulated industries.
